title: dog10k cohort genotyping pipeline parameters
description: Cohort-wide stage of the dog10k mapping workflow: joint SNP calling with hard filtering for HighPass samples, and GLIMPSE v1.1 imputation + PLINK conversion for LowPass samples. Must be run exactly once, over the complete accumulated sample set produced by code/01_mapping/1_fetch_map's batches.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define sample inputs and where results are published.

high_pass_samplesheet.description: Cohort samplesheet for HighPass samples (per-sample BAM/GVCF/depth paths).
high_pass_samplesheet.help_text: CSV file with columns: sample, bam, bai, gvcf, gvcf_tbi, depth_stats. One row per sample. Accumulated across all of 1_fetch_map's HighPass batches by analyses/00_fetch-raw-data/run_batched.sh. Must conform to assets/schemas/schema_cohort_input.json.

low_pass_samplesheet.description: Cohort samplesheet for LowPass samples (per-sample BAM/GVCF/depth paths).
low_pass_samplesheet.help_text: Same format as high_pass_samplesheet. Accumulated across ALL of 1_fetch_map's LowPass batches — GLIMPSE_LIKELIHOODS requires every LowPass BAM to be present in this one samplesheet for correct cohort-wide genotype likelihoods.

reference_genome.title: Reference genome
reference_genome.description: Paths to the UU_Cfam_GSD_1.0 assembly and associated reference files. All files are available from https://github.com/jmkidd/dogmap.

assembly_ref.description: Path to the reference genome FASTA (UU_Cfam_GSD_1.0_ROSY.fa).
assembly_ref.help_text: All associated index files (.fai, .dict, bwa-mem2 indices) must be co-located in the same directory as this FASTA. The pipeline discovers them automatically by filename prefix matching.

chunks_dir.description: Directory containing BED files that split the genome into processing chunks (chunks_10/).
chunks_dir.help_text: Expected to contain chunk_1.bed through chunk_11.bed. Chunks 1-10 cover autosomes and sex chromosomes; chunk_11 covers unplaced contigs. Used by GENOTYPE_CALLING for parallel processing.

glimpse_imputation.title: GLIMPSE imputation
glimpse_imputation.description: Reference panel for GLIMPSE v1.1 low-pass imputation. Downloaded from https://kiddlabshare.med.umich.edu/dog10K/phased-imputation-panel/.

glimpse_ref_panel.help_text: BCF file containing the phased reference haplotypes. The .csi index must exist at ${glimpse_ref_panel}.csi. Used by GLIMPSE_DEFINE_CHUNKS, GLIMPSE_VARIABLE_SITES, and GLIMPSE_IMPUTE_CHUNKS.
